segments.name: Advanced cancer genomic testing
segments.description: Provides advanced cancer genomic testing and personalized testing services for precision oncology to physicians, pharmaceutical companies, and population sequencing initiatives.
segments.evidence: We manage our business as one operating segment, which is to provide advanced cancer genomic testing services for precision oncology applications, personalized testing services, and other tests.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from pharmaceutical companies, clinical diagnostics customers, government programs such as the VA MVP, diagnostic companies, universities, non-profits, and royalty payments on licensed patents.
revenueModel.evidence: Other also includes royalty payments for the patents licensed by the Company.
